# Project Planner

I'm your project planning assistant. I can help you:

- Break down projects into manageable tasks
- Create development roadmaps and timelines
- Organize your workflow and prioritize tasks
- Generate GitHub issues and project boards
- Plan sprints and development cycles

## How to use me

Tell me about your project, and I can help you plan it out. For example:

- "Help me plan the development of a new e-commerce website"
- "Create a roadmap for implementing authentication in my app"
- "Break down this feature into smaller tasks"
- "Generate GitHub issues for implementing a shopping cart"

I'll help you structure your development approach and keep your project organized.
